caption: The drawing features a centrally placed, realistic depiction of a wooden stamp with a rectangular base and an angled handle. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown with visible darker streaks indicating the grain. The base of the stamp has a carved pattern, appearing to be letters or a symbol. On the upper right side of the paper, there is a faint, outlined sketch of the stamp shown from the side, without color, detailing its shape. In the bottom left corner, there is another outlined drawing depicting the imprint this stamp would leave, which shows the letters "F H" inside a rectangular box. At the lower right of the image, the name "Carl Keksi" is printed. The background is plain and off-white with no additional elements or shading.
title: Wooden Stamp
